title: Version 1.19.0
body:
Version 1.19.0

July 6th, 2023

New Content:

  • Added the long awaited Intersection Conveyor
  • Added $250,000 cash purchase

Changes:

  • Spores are now client sided to prevent latency
  • Spores now only damage their initial target
  • Spores no-longer shake the screen
  • Stat tool now works on Trailers
  • Revamped particles on Forges and Refineries
  • Revamped Robux store UI

Bug Fixes:

  • Removed Crash Dummy achievement due to a massive flaw effecting performance :(
